home.why.title: Why ToolkitLife
home.why.intro: ToolkitLife is a collection of 379 free online tools and calculators across 16 categories — from PDF converters and image editors to mortgage, BMI and tax calculators. Every tool works right in your browser: nothing to install and no account required.
home.why.privacy: Your files stay private: image, video and document tools process everything locally with <mdn>WebAssembly</mdn> — your data never leaves your device.
home.why.i18n: The site is available in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Russian, and every tool page includes a step-by-step guide plus answers to common questions.
home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.items.0.question: Is ToolkitLife free?
home.faq.items.0.answer: Yes. All 379 tools are completely free with no signup, no subscription and no usage limits. Processing happens on your device, so there are no server costs to pass on.
home.faq.items.1.question: Are my files uploaded to a server?
home.faq.items.1.answer: No. Every tool runs entirely in your browser using JavaScript and WebAssembly. Files, text and images are processed locally and never sent to any server.
home.faq.items.2.question: Do I need to create an account?
home.faq.items.2.answer: No. There is no account system — open a tool and use it. Favorites and recently used tools are stored only in your own browser.
home.faq.items.3.question: Which devices and browsers are supported?
home.faq.items.3.answer: Any modern browser on desktop, tablet or phone — Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari. Tools adapt to your screen size, and nothing needs to be installed.
home.faq.items.4.question: Are the calculators reliable?
home.faq.items.4.answer: They apply standard formulas and provide estimates for general information only. Financial, health and legal tools include a disclaimer and are not a substitute for professional advice.
